stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[3].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

composite_key.statement: Rows are duplicates only if all key columns match; rows differing in any key column are kept.

keep_first.statement: Strategy first keeps the earliest row of each key, in original order.

keep_last.statement: Strategy last keeps the latest row of each key, ordered by position of that row.

error_strategy.statement: Strategy error with duplicates exits non-zero, reports duplicate keys with row numbers, and writes no output file.

output_csv.statement: The output CSV contains the input header followed by the surviving rows.

summary.statement: The CLI prints the number of duplicates found and removed (error strategy: found, removed 0).
must_include: summary of duplicates found and removed

missing_column.statement: A key column absent from the header exits non-zero and names the missing column; a missing input file also exits non-zero.

single_file_stdlib.statement: data_dedup.py is one file and imports only standard library modules.
